title: Gourmet authorized catalogue snapshot · supported contract v1
description: Structural contract only. A matching JSON document does not grant commercial authority. The server must resolve an owner-approved source and use commercial scope with durable identity. No default prices or percentages.

authority.description: Assigned by the trusted server adapter after approval evidence is resolved; never accepted as authority from the browser or an uploaded file alone.

approvalRef.description: Reference to the owner's approval of this exact catalogue snapshot; no credentials.

source.description: Identifiable approved source/version, shown as inert text. This field never instructs the app to fetch a URL.

currency.description: Current implementation supports USD cents only. This is a technical limit, not an assertion of Gourmet's business currency. Other currencies require explicit contract changes; no automatic conversion.

validUntilMs.description: Unix epoch milliseconds. Runtime additionally requires this to be later than its current clock, including after waiting for the transaction lock.

taxBps.description: Owner-authorized tax applied once to the subtotal in basis points, half-up. Missing is not zero. Compound/multiple taxes are unsupported.

depositBps.description: Owner-authorized requested deposit applied to total including tax, half-up. Not a payment, charge or accepted debt.

terms.description: Approved quotation terms, validity and operational limitations. No assumed reservation or vendor acceptance.

id.description: Unique within the snapshot; duplicate IDs are rejected by runtime even if other item fields differ.

unit.description: Explicit unit basis, for example person or service, supplied by the authorized catalogue; not inferred from the event.

unitPriceCents.description: Exact cents from the approved source. Client commands only supply itemId and integer quantity 1–1000.
